settings.headline: You pack.
settings.subtitle: A surprise trip is still your trip. You tell us what you love, and we use that to choose a place you'd never have picked, but will be very glad you went.

settings.headline: Four steps to
settings.subtitle: From the first question to the airport.

steps.title: Tell us what you love
steps.text: Pick a trip, your dates and your home airport. Tell us what you love and anywhere you'd rather not go. Five minutes, tops.

steps.title: We plan everything
steps.text: We pick the place and book flights, hotels and a few things worth doing. You get a fixed quote by email before anything is booked.

steps.title: Pack from the clues
steps.text: A week before, a clue card and a packing list arrive, with the weather. That's all you get.

steps.title: Open it at the airport
steps.text: Your sealed envelope holds the destination, your boarding passes and a pocket guide. Open it at check-in and go.

settings.caption: Kyoto · Long Haul · April 2025
settings.headline: We read
settings.body: Every trip starts with a person, not a destination. We look at what you love, what you've ruled out, when you can go and how far you're happy to fly, and then a real planner on our team spends a few hours on it. We pick places that will be good in the month you travel: the right weather, no huge festival you'd hate, and a hotel you'll want to come back to.

points.title: Never somewhere you've been
points.text: Tell us your list and we rule it all out.

points.title: Right for the season
points.text: Monsoon, heatwave or festival crowds are all checked.

points.title: Built around you
points.text: Mobility, diet, kids, a fear of boats: tell us and we plan for it.

settings.caption: Porto · Classic · May 2026
settings.headline: What's inside
settings.body: Your envelope holds the destination, boarding passes, hotel confirmations, the times of anything we've booked and a pocket guide written for your trip, with our favourite places to eat, drink and wander. Everything is in your email too, sealed away in a single link until the morning you fly.

points.title: Tickets and bookings
points.text: Flights, hotels and experiences, all confirmed.

points.title: A pocket guide
points.text: Written for your trip, not a generic city guide.

points.title: A message line to us
points.text: A real person, from 7 a.m. to midnight your time.

settings.headline: We've probably been asked
settings.subtitle: Passports, peeking, prices and what happens if you've already been there.
